messages.subject: bifactor and across group constraints
parts: Hi Phil and all:  Thanks for the suggestion on the download problem.  I was running bfactor in a multiple group problem (2 groups) in a designed missing data problem (mimicing a 2-stage testing procedure.)  If I constrain the slopes across groups the coeficient estimates seem quite reasonable and agree with output from the summary command.  When I constrain both the slopes and intercepts in the bifactor model the coeficients are indeed the same across the groups but when I use the summary command only the specific factor loading are equivalent across factors.  Both models converge so I expect the trouble (if any) lies in the summary command. I am attaching script and data file.  Thanks again for any help  Don Rock

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: bifactor and across group constraints
parts:
Standardized loadings also take into account the variance of the latent traits. So if these aren't equal across groups then the standardized loadings will differ (only the raw coefs are constrained to be equal). The same effect occurs in traditional CFA analysis as well.  

Phil
